title: Professional summary
summary: Karan is a software and machine learning engineer who combines production-scale engineering, applied ML research, and product development
content: Karan Rajendra is a New York-based software and machine learning engineer. His background combines production engineering at Meta and Instagram, machine learning research at Stony Brook University, graduate teaching, and end-to-end applied ML products.

title: Education and coursework
summary: Karan has a strong computer engineering and computer science academic foundation
content: Karan is completing a Master of Science in Computer Engineering at Stony Brook University from August 2024 to May 2026 with a 3.9 GPA. His coursework includes Machine Learning, Deep Learning, Natural Language Processing, Distributed Systems, and Advanced Algorithms. He also holds a Bachelor of Engineering in Computer Science from Visvesvaraya Technological University.

title: Location and opportunity status
summary: Karan is based in New York and is available for machine learning engineering opportunities
content: Karan is based in New York. His portfolio states that he is available for machine learning engineering opportunities and open to relocation.

title: Meta and Instagram engineering impact
summary: Karan delivered measurable engineering impact on production-scale data at Meta and Instagram
content: As a Software Engineer at Meta and Instagram, Karan built Instagram's first cohort-analysis pipeline and a behavioral clustering framework. The system processed 1.2 billion user pairs, identified 500 million unique users, improved pipeline performance by 5 times, and reduced Business Compute Unit consumption by 50 percent.

title: Product analytics and cross-functional decisions
summary: Karan connected large-scale engineering work to product experiments and decisions
content: At Meta and Instagram, Karan developed Instagram Story interaction signals, multi-signal clustering, and monitoring dashboards for adoption and experiments. His work addressed data sparsity and user segmentation and supported cross-functional product decisions.

title: Machine learning research results
summary: Karan has delivered measurable results across NLP, author-style detection, and multimodal speech research
content: As a Research Assistant at Stony Brook University, Karan improved author-style detection from 87 to 92 percent ROC-AUC across more than 40 million documents, achieved 96 percent speaker diarization accuracy across more than 680 interviews, and produced persuasive responses that outperformed human responses by 6 percent.

title: Research methods and models
summary: Karan applies modern language-model fine-tuning and speech-processing methods
content: Karan fine-tuned Llama 2-7B with LoRA and Direct Preference Optimization on r/ChangeMyView data, reaching 0.7 reward accuracy. His research also uses Transformers, PyTorch, WhisperX, and NVIDIA NeMo for large-scale text and multimodal speech analysis.

title: Teaching, mentorship, and communication
summary: Karan demonstrates communication and mentorship through graduate-level machine learning teaching
content: As a Graduate Teaching Assistant, Karan guided more than 40 graduate students through supervised learning, deep learning, feature engineering, model evaluation, and Python debugging. This experience demonstrates his ability to explain technical concepts and support others through complex work.

title: Sentinel counterparty risk system
summary: Sentinel demonstrates rigorous predictive modeling and explainable risk decisions
content: Sentinel benchmarks Logistic Regression, Random Forest, and HistGradientBoosting on 20,000 synthetic longitudinal records using a strict temporal holdout. It achieved 0.724 ROC-AUC and 0.0197 calibrated expected calibration error, and includes Platt scaling, local prediction explanations, a risk action queue, and inverse propensity weighting.

title: Speech emotion detection product
summary: The speech emotion project demonstrates full-stack multimodal machine learning
content: Karan built a full-stack speech emotion journaling application using Keras, Librosa, FastAPI, and React. The classifier uses speech features and a CNN-BiLSTM-Attention architecture across 12,162 source audio clips, predicts eight emotion classes, and achieved 73 percent test accuracy.

title: RoleFit and portfolio assistant products
summary: Karan builds explainable NLP products with user-facing workflows
content: RoleFit is an upload-first resume analyzer with target-role scoring, ATS checks, evidence-safe bullet rewrites, and before-and-after comparison. The AI Portfolio Assistant retrieves cited evidence about Karan's experience, skills, projects, and measurable impact, and abstains when portfolio evidence is insufficient.

title: Core technical toolkit
summary: Karan combines machine learning, software engineering, data, and cloud skills
content: Karan's core toolkit includes Python, SQL, C++, Java, TypeScript, Scala, PyTorch, TensorFlow, Hugging Face, Transformers, Scikit-learn, Spark, FastAPI, Docker, Airflow, GCP, AWS, Azure, Weights and Biases, and CI/CD.

title: Data science and machine learning capabilities
summary: Karan covers the full applied data science workflow from feature engineering to evaluation
content: Karan's data science capabilities include NumPy, Pandas, SciPy, Statsmodels, feature engineering, model evaluation, causal inference, predictive modeling, Matplotlib, Tableau, and Power BI. His work demonstrates deep learning, NLP, multimodal ML, calibration, and explainability.

title: Backend, data platform, and deployment capabilities
summary: Karan can move machine learning work into usable backend and data systems
content: Karan's backend and data platform experience includes FastAPI, Flask, REST APIs, Spark, PostgreSQL, MySQL, MongoDB, Redis, HDFS, Docker, Airflow, GCP, AWS, Azure, and CI/CD.
